name: -6 AN to 1/4" NPT 45 Degree Elbow Adapter
title: -6 AN to 1/4" NPT 45 Degree Elbow Adapter
description:
The -6 AN to 1/4" NPT 45 Degree Elbow Adapter is a premium high-performance component engineered for rigorous fluid and boost applications. ColorFittings AN to NPT 45 Degree Elbow Adapter Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to NPT ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, and power steering plumbing systems.

their AN to NPT Adapters are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with their nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these adapters deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance plumbing system.

For best installation results, the manufacturer strongly recommend using their AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference their installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined in the USA. (6061-T6 Billet Aluminum for fittings)
• Flow Configuration: 45° mandrel-bent profile for maximum velocity.
